segments.text: Welcome to the IsItLegit judge getting-started guide. You have two zero-friction ways to verify the system in under sixty seconds: on the live web, or locally with zero API keys.

Path one is the live web at isitlegit.co.za and app.isitlegit.co.za, pre-populated with our Fynbos Freight demo organisation. Forward any suspicious email to check@isitlegit.co.za, or upload an email, a PDF invoice or an Opus voice note on slash check. Append question-mark trace equals one and clock equals one to any report URL to open the live model trace and inspect Muse Spark one point three, SAM 3.1, Muse Wonder one point zero, Loupe, and Muse Voice Transcribe one point zero, then check slash eval and our open-weight LoRA adapter on Hugging Face.

Path two is zero-account local replay. Run pnpm install and pnpm judge colon demo. It runs the real Worker pipeline locally against recorded Meta Model API and Fireworks AI request and response pairs, with explicit provenance badges on every report.
Try the live web at isitlegit.co.za, or run pnpm judge colon demo locally. Thanks for judging IsItLegit.
